summary: Removes a duplicate setup request when an active platform administrator opens a verified organization workspace.
userImpact: The dashboard can show results as soon as the workspace reads finish.
security: Workspace access still requires matching authenticated session context and permission checks.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding compatible frontend image.
validation: Frontend unit tests preserve the setup guard for standalone deployments and delegated administrators.
Chromium and Firefox open and reload an authenticated pooled workspace with no duplicate setup request.

customerDocumentation.reason: The improvement requires no user or administrator action.
